```{r crew, echo=FALSE, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Builds the people cards from people.yml (see the comments in that file).
people <- yaml::yaml.load(paste(readLines("people.yml", encoding = "UTF-8", warn = FALSE), collapse = "\n"))

card <- function(p) {
  photo <- if (!is.null(p$photo) && file.exists(p$photo)) {
    sprintf('<img class="person-photo" src="%s" alt="Photo of %s" loading="lazy">', p$photo, p$name)
  } else {
    '<img class="person-photo is-placeholder" src="images/people/corn-ear.svg" alt="">'
  }
  links <- ""
  if (length(p$links)) {
    links <- paste0('<p class="person-links">', paste(vapply(p$links, function(l)
      sprintf('<a href="%s" aria-label="%s"><i class="fa %s" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>',
              l$url, l$label, l$icon), ""), collapse = " "), "</p>")
  }
  paste0("::: {.person-card}\n", photo, "\n\n",
         '<p class="person-name">', p$name, "</p>\n\n",
         "[", p$role, "]{.person-role}\n\n",
         if (!is.null(p$bio)) paste0(p$bio, "\n\n") else "",
         links, "\n:::\n\n")
}

for (g in people$current) {
  cat("### ", g$group, "\n\n:::: {.people-grid}\n", sep = "")
  for (p in g$members) cat(card(p))
  cat("::::\n\n")
}

cat("### **Former lab members**\n\n::: {.former-list}\n")
for (p in people$former) cat("- **", p$name, "** ", p$role, "\n", sep = "")
cat(":::\n")
```
